new_jobs.jd: **Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for *all* .** Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever. ****Role Summary And Key Responsibilities**** The **GQ QMO Enterprise Process Analyst** plays a critical role in driving operational excellence, process governance, and continuous improvement across Micron's enterprise quality management system. This position combines system-level process stewardship, change governance leadership, and New Product Introduction (NPI) process optimization to ensure business processes remain effective, compliant, scalable, and aligned with Micron's strategic objectives. This role is designed for an experienced professional who excels at the intersection of **business process management, systems governance, operational analytics, and cross-functional collaboration** . new_jobs.title: Leader, Product Operations
new_jobs.jd: **Meet the Team** Our team is a dynamic and collaborative group united by a shared passion for innovation and a commitment to excellence. We foster a culture of open communication, mutual respect, and continuous learning, where every voice is valued and encouraged to contribute. Our mission is **Think Really Big, Play to Win, Drive Durable Growth.** What truly makes us an exciting place to work is our dedication to pushing boundaries, embracing new ideas, and celebrating both individual achievements and collective successes. We offer a stimulating environment where you can grow your career, make a real impact, and be part of something truly meaningful. **Your Impact** The Cisco Product Operations team is looking for a visionary and experienced leader to scale and provide strategic oversight for our integrated product operations team. You will be responsible for influencing and driving organizational strategy, mentoring a high-performing team of engineers and program managers, and driving operational excellence across the full product lifecycle. This is a high-visibility role where you will influence cross-functional stakeholders including Engineering, Manufacturing, GSM, and Executive Leadership to ensure our products meet the highest standards of quality, reliability, and cost-competitiveness. **High-Level Responsibilities** * Define and execute the strategic roadmap for the product operations organization to support global scale and efficiency. * Provide leadership and career mentorship to a diverse team of Electrical, Mechanical, and Test Development Engineers and Program Managers. * Foster deep collaboration with Hardware Engineering and Supply Chain partners to ensure seamless transitions from NPI through End-of-Life. * Oversee organizational quality benchmarks and drive proactive risk mitigation across the product portfolio. * Champion value engineering and cost avoidance initiatives to maximize gross margins and operational profitability. * Facilitate executive-level communications to provide status updates, performance insights, and strategic recommendations. * Lead the development of processes and technology frameworks that enable our teams to innovate faster and solve complex technical challenges. * Ensure adherence to rigorous operational standards and financial stewardship across all hardware programs. **Minimum Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, or a related technical field. * 10+ years of progressive experience in product operations, supply chain, or engineering leadership within the high-tech industry. * Proven track record of building and leading high-performing, cross-functional teams in a matrixed environment. * Expertise in full product lifecycle management (NPI to EOL) and deep understanding of manufacturing dynamics. * Advanced ability to influence executive stakeholders and drive strategy without direct authority. * Outstanding written, verbal communication, and interpersonal skills. * Demonstrated success in managing complex budgets and operational performance metrics. **Preferred Qualifications** * Master’s degree in Engineering or an MBA. * Experience leading large-scale electronics manufacturing operations or hyper-scaler infrastructure programs. * Certification in Project Management (PMP) or process improvement methodologies (Six Sigma). * Deep familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies and enterprise PLM systems. * Experience scaling organizations through periods of significant growth or technical transformation. Why Cisco? At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

new_jobs.jd: **Description** AWS Professional Services (ProServe) is seeking an experienced Taiwan ProServe Area Leader to lead and grow the AWS ProServe business. This is a pivotal, first-of-its-kind leadership role responsible for building and overseeing both the Sales and Delivery functions of the AWS Professional Services business in Taiwan. This leader owns the P&L for the Taiwan practice, driving revenue growth, building high-performing teams, and leading transformative cloud and GenAI consulting engagements for Taiwan’s largest enterprises across IT strategy, migration, modernization, and cloud adoption. As the Taiwan Leader, you will be the single-threaded owner of the Taiwan ProServe business, with dual responsibility focused on driving Sales (business development, pipeline generation, revenue growth, and go-to-market strategy) and oversight of the Delivery function (ensuring successful execution of cloud transformation programs, delivery quality, and customer satisfaction). You will establish the ProServe presence in Taiwan, define the market strategy, and build the team and mechanisms needed to scale the business. The leader also contributes at the world-wide level to shape the cloud-based IT consulting model of the future, including Generative AI. Key job responsibilities Lead and inspire the AWS ProServe team that will fuel the growth of the Taiwan market and deliver outsized impact for customers. Measured against Revenue, Billable Bookings, pipeline growth, partner contribution, delivery quality, and customer satisfaction. Key Responsibilities Position customers for success — collaborate with AWS field sales to develop strong customer and partner relationships with CIOs, CTOs, IT functional leaders, and business sponsor executives across Taiwan. Lead sales and delivery — own the Taiwan ProServe revenue target (bookings, revenue, margin); build and manage a robust pipeline of large-scale cloud transformation opportunities including migration, modernization, data & analytics, and Generative AI. Shape complex transformations — work directly with customers and AWS field sales, support, training, technical, and specialty teams to shape projects, programs, and strategy for enterprises going through digital transformation, data centre exits, Generative AI adoption, migrations, and modernization. Build the partner ecosystem — establish executive and technical relationships with key integrators, software vendors, and managed services providers; deliver joint proposals and co-sell/co-deliver engagements to help partners succeed in large, complex customer engagements using AWS. Deliver value — oversee high-quality delivery of customised engagements with partners and enterprise customers; own customer feedback, corrective actions, and continuous improvement of delivery outcomes. Lead great teams — attract and develop top talent to build high-performing teams with superior technical depth and outstanding customer relationship skills; coach on consultative selling, deal pursuit, account planning, and delivery excellence. Key Capabilities Customer Obsession: Strong relationship-building skills at the most senior level and a relentless focus on what it takes to make customers successful. Revenue Driven Mindset: Focuses on customer business outcomes and increasing platform production usage; demonstrated ability to shape and execute large, complex deals. Strong Operator: Can dive deep, innovate, and drive quality in all aspects of execution — projects, people, platform, programs, and partners. Earn Trust: Ability to influence without authority; can work effectively with partners and within a matrix organisation. Hire and Develop the Best: Outstanding people leadership skills with the ability to attract and develop senior industry and technical leaders who will build and scale teams and businesses. Think Big: Innovative thinker and transformative leader who can look around corners, identify the next opportunity to build and grow the Taiwan business; able to partner with CxOs and articulate a business-minded value proposition. Strong Understanding of Digital Transformation: Leader who has worked on or worked closely with teams on large-scale digital transformation. **About The Team** Diverse Experiences AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying. Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. Inclusive Team Culture AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do. Mentorship & Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional. Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve. **Basic Qualifications** * 10+ years of experience in technology sales, professional services, IT consulting, or cloud services * 5+ years of experience in a people management role, leading sales or delivery teams * Demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets in a professional services or technology consulting environment * Experience working in the Taiwan market with established enterprise customer relationships; managing complex, multi-stakeholder deal cycles with enterprise customers * Fluency in Mandarin Chinese and English (business-level proficiency required in both) **Preferred Qualifications** * MBA or advanced degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field * Generative AI fluency, famailarity with AWS services and broader AWS ecosystem * Experience in both sales leadership and delivery/program management roles within professional services * Experience with cloud migration, application modernization, data & analytics, and/or Generative AI initiatives * Strong understanding of cloud technologies, digital transformation trends, and the professional services business model * Deep network of C-level and senior executive relationships across Taiwan enterprise and public sector; experience developing and managing strategic partner relationships * Understanding of the regulatory and business environment across the Taiwan market Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. new_jobs.title: Principal Engineer - Digital AI, Consumer TIC
new_jobs.jd: **Job Description** Principal Engineer - Digital AI, Consumer TIC serves as the Global Subject Matter Expert for Digital AI technologies, enabling UL Solutions to develop standards, certification, assurance, training, advisory, and assessment services across digital AI systems. This role provides technical leadership for AI governance, enterprise and cloud AI, predictive and Generative AI, foundation and frontier models, AI agents and agentic workflows, multi-agent systems, and AI lifecycle assurance. The position translates emerging technologies, regulations, standards, and customer needs into scalable UL Solutions offerings that strengthen the company's AI standards and services portfolio. This is a hybrid role requiring 3 days onsite in any UL office globally. Remote will be considered for candidates not local to an office. **Qualifications** **Must Have** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline. Advanced degree preferred. * 15+ years of technical experience in software platforms, cloud systems, AI/ML systems, cybersecurity, technology risk, model lifecycle management, digital assurance, or related technology domains, including 5+ years of direct experience working with AI technologies. * Demonstrated experience translating AI governance, model risk management, and regulatory requirements into practical evaluation methodologies, controls, assurance frameworks, certification programs, or customer-facing services. * Demonstrated ability to evaluate and test AI systems and identify failure modes, risks, and control gaps, including model performance, transparency, traceability, explainability, reliability, robustness, human-in-the-loop controls, fairness and bias, privacy, security, accountability, and operational resilience. * Working knowledge of AI evaluation and testing methodologies, including benchmarking, scenario-based testing, red teaming, bias and fairness evaluation, robustness testing, model monitoring, and assessment of risk-mitigation controls. * Working knowledge of predictive AI and machine learning, Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), foundation and frontier models, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), AI agents, multi-agent systems, and associated technical, operational, and governance risks, including hallucinations, prompt injection, jailbreaks, data leakage, model drift, unsafe actions, and output reliability. * Strong presentation, technical writing, thought leadership, and stakeholder engagement capabilities. **Preferred to Have** * Advanced degree in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Robotics, Computer Science, Data Science, or a related technical discipline. * Familiarity with AI governance frameworks, standards, and emerging global AI regulatory requirements. * Experience developing or applying standards, conformity assessment methodologies, certification programs, audit frameworks, testing approaches, technical requirements, or commercial services for emerging technologies. * Demonstrated ability to influence customers, regulators, standards committees, industry forums, cross-functional business leaders, and technical stakeholders. **What we offer:** * US Total Rewards: We understand compensation is an important factor as you consider the next step in your career. The estimated salary range for this position is $155,000-$250,000 and is based on multiple factors, including job-related knowledge/skills, experience, geographical location, as well as other factors. This position is eligible for annual bonus compensation with a target payout of 20% of the base salary. This position also provides health benefits such as medical, dental and vision; wellness benefits such as mental and financial health; and retirement savings (401K) commensurate with the standard rewards offered in each individual location or country. We also provide full-time employees with paid time off including vacation (15 days), holiday including floating holidays (12 days) and sick time off (72 hours).
